name: Raúl Uranga – Carlos Sylvestre Begnis Subfluvial Tunnel
wikipediaTitle: Raúl Uranga – Carlos Sylvestre Begnis Subfluvial Tunnel
facts: Opened on 13 December 1969, the Raúl Uranga – Carlos Sylvestre Begnis Subfluvial Tunnel was the first underwater road link between Entre Ríos and Santa Fe, a milestone after decades of stalled proposals.

Each of the tunnel’s 65.45‑meter, 4,500‑tonne immersed tubes boasts 50‑cm thick walls and a 10.8‑meter diameter, creating a 7.5‑meter‑wide roadway that dips 32 meters below the Paraná River’s surface.
In 2004, the tunnel handled 2,780,133 vehicles—almost 2.2 million cars and motorcycles—highlighting its crucial role before the Rosario‑Victoria Bridge opened.
